definitions.ask: How long may a step keep waiting on contention before tick reports it failed?
definitions.why: about 8 refs retries, so real churn surfaces the same morning

choices.label: 2 hours; a stuck lock or churn loop mails within about one morning hour block
6 hours; quieter, matching the refs full-scan interval
1 hour; fastest alert, but long user-driven lock holds may still mail
